title: People that reads well at any text size, and boards from each room
changes: People no longer draws the Nostr messages button over the public profiles note, and long names end neatly.
On a short screen the whole People column scrolls, so the switch, search and list stay usable.
Boards now open from each room rather than from the side rail.
The side rail and its buttons grow with larger text sizes.
Room info closes when you move to another part of the app.
A room's tasks open reliably while the room is still joining.
